title: From Unlearning to UNBRANDING: A Benchmark for Trademark-Safe Text-to-Image Generation
reasoning: The paper defines and benchmarks a new task for removing trademarks and 'trade dress' features from generative models. While it mentions 'ethical use' and 'brand safety' as motivations, its evaluation focus is strictly on brand identity removal and visual fidelity, not on religion, morals, or ethical frameworks.
